reply.thought: The handoff claims refunds are applied, but I must verify them against the refunds table before any payout. Starting by listing refunds.

All three refunds in the handoff (orders 250, 251, 255) match the refunds table exactly by order_id and amount. Next I need the orders so I can identify the customers before getting their net balances.

All three refunds match the refunds table by order_id and amount, so I can proceed. Orders map to customers acme (250, 253), birch (251, 254), and cobalt (252, 255). I'll get each customer's net balance from net_balance, starting with acme.
Acme's net balance is 5519 cents. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
Acme and birch net balances are in hand. Cobalt is the last customer, so I need its net balance before recording any payouts.

Each refund matches the refunds table, and the net balances check out against the orders (acme 20065-14546=5519, birch 15118-1481=13637, cobalt 53824-12535=41289). Recording the first payout, for acme.
Acme's payout of 5519 is recorded. Birch's net balance of 13637 matches orders 251 and 254 (2763 + 12355 = 15118) less refund 251 (1481). Recording birch's payout next, then cobalt's.

Continuing the batch: cobalt's net balance is 41289, which matches orders 252 and 255 (36165 + 17659 = 53824) less refund 255 (12535). Recording cobalt's payout now, which completes the three-customer batch.
All three payouts were recorded successfully after verifying each refund against the refunds table and checking the net balances against the orders. The batch is complete.
